label: Solo fallback
description: What a lone player can do in a multi-seat unit.

terms.label: Full control
terms.description: One player can drive and fire everything; extra seats add weapons, spotting or passenger effects.
examples: C&C Renegade: the driver takes over the weapon whenever the gunner seat is empty
Battlefield tanks: the driver has the main gun

terms.label: Seat swap
terms.description: Alone, one key switches seats: drive or shoot, not both.
examples: PlanetSide 2: solo Liberator pilots switch to the belly gun mid-fight

terms.label: Auto-gunner
terms.description: Empty gun seats fire on their own at reduced accuracy until a player takes them.
examples: Titanfall: the Titan fights on its own when the pilot is out
Halo campaign: computer-controlled gunners man the turret

terms.label: Needs crew
terms.description: A seat's weapon or ability does nothing without a player in it.
examples: Foxhole: only the engineer seat can reload a battle tank's main gun
